definitions.Einstein_error: E=||Ric+3g||_g/6, physical normalization1; multiply by100 for percent.
definitions.core_inventory: 96 chambers +176 open arcs +80 intersections =352 exact-core representatives; all coincident branches retained. This is finite representative coverage, not a uniform smoothness proof.
definitions.directional_bending: max absolute eigenvalue of ((h_A+h_B)/2)^{-1}(K_A-s_F K_B), in inverse curvature-radius units. Canonical normal sign occurs exactly once.
definitions.directional_length: d=max(sqrt(lambda_max),1/sqrt(lambda_min))-1, lambda eigenvalues of h_A^{-1} h_B. Side-symmetric bound on all directional tangent-length ratios.
definitions.face_scope: 8 existing development rows per each384 face portions, all96pairs; equal-pair/equal-family weighted RMS and unweighted sample percentiles. No volume-fraction interpretation.
definitions.profiles_scope: Two fixed radial lines with513 samples and nested257 subset, four native cusp lines with129 samples each; no global supremum claim.
definitions.signed_core_angle_defect: 2*pi - sum of oriented positive-width sector angles in g_NN-g_NT g_TT^{-1}g_TN. Positive means angular deficit; negative excess. Reported maxima/q99 use absolute value.
